release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision TNU-X6320A* series datasheet (DataSheet_TNU-X6320A1WT1-M_20260831_EN.pdf). The series datasheet covers all TNU-X6320A* variants; this record's input voltage (24VAC), temperature rating (T1: -40 to 60 C), no fiber module and certification suffix are decoded from the datasheet's model-number key (1=24VAC, 2=110VAC; T1/T2; F2=single-mode fiber; W=wiper; C=cLC CSA, M=INMETRO, Z=cLCus C1/D1). Merged SKUs TNU-X6320A1WT1-M, TNU-X6320A1WT1-Z (identical specs, differ only by certification region). Power (max 80W) and weight (33kg) are the series' stated maxima ("up to", "depending on model"). The series sheet lists "WDR (150dB)" in one features line but 120dB in the WDR row and key features; 120dB recorded. Digital zoom stated 16x (key features) vs 32x (operational table); 16x recorded. Autotracking not stated. Weight is given only as a maximum (up to 33 kg), so weight_g is not recorded.
